actions: harness-defined browser actions through the task's local browser service

counts.population: hidden test cases summed over the docs/tasks.md table

benchmark_protocol.evaluation: Hidden test cases per task. A case passes when its functional checks pass and every visual checkpoint's flat-baseline-normalized RGB SSIM reaches 0.99. A task's reward is passed cases divided by cases, weighted equally.
focus: full-stack website reconstruction from browser exploration, without the source code
visual appearance and functional behavior of the rebuilt site
benchmark_protocol.notes: Agents run through selectable Harbor agents, so observations and actions depend on the agent. Each task requests 8 CPUs, 8 GiB of memory and 20 GiB of disk per environment, with up to 16 hours for the agent.

code.basis: repository LICENSE header; not a weights/data license

name: WebsiteBench
notes: Read at commit 78f5558e. The README and docs/tasks.md were reviewed; the 70 tasks and 46,916 hidden cases were checked by summing the docs/tasks.md table. The README's paper badge has no link and the project page says the paper is coming soon, so no paper relation is recorded. Apache-2.0 is the README's statement for benchmark code, task definitions and verifier. Leaderboard scores were not checked. Nothing was installed or run.
summary: Website reconstruction benchmark: agents explore a production-level site through a browser, rebuild a full-stack version, and are scored by hidden functional and visual test cases across 70 tasks.
